solutions.title: Nested search
solutions.strategy: For each nums1 value, scan nums2 for the first unused matching index.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Used flags track consumed duplicate indices.

solutions.title: Index queues
solutions.strategy: Map each value in nums2 to a queue of matching indices, then pop one index per nums1 value.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Queues store every index of nums2.
